title.suggested: Benefit Exhibition for Tom Allen at Madison Square Garden

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that at a benefit for Tom Allen at Madison Square Garden, John L. Sullivan spoke and shook hands with him, and Allen seemed no match for George Rooke in the wind-up.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Wednesday, November 29, 1882', page 8. 'Monday evening' was November 27, 1882.

facts.fact: A boxing exhibition complimentary to Allen was given at Madison Square Garden; Allen sparred the wind-up with George Rooke, seemed no match for him and fell heavily at the end of the last round
John L. Sullivan, in the audience, took the stage to deny he was afraid of Allen, and the two shook hands

notes: The current summary leaves out that Allen sparred Rooke and did poorly, which is the main point. The paragraph is the lead item about Allen, so focus primary.
